records.question: Reconstruct the timeline of the March 12, 2026 outage, from the change that triggered it to recovery.
records.gold_answer: 13:55 UTC CHG-1042 deployed; 14:02 UTC impact began; 14:41 UTC CHG-1042 rolled back; 14:58 UTC recovered (the status page says 14:15 and 15:10 UTC)
records.answer: 13:55 UTC – CHG‑1042 deployed (ledger pool reduced); 14:02 UTC – outage begins; 14:15 UTC – SEV1 declared; 14:41 UTC – CHG‑1042 rolled back; 14:58 UTC – payments recovered; 15:05 UTC – CHG‑1045 scales notification workers; 16:30 UTC – webhook backlog cleared.

claims.text: The outage was triggered by Change CHG-1042, which reduced the ledger service's database connection pool max_connections from 200 to 20 and was deployed at 13:55 UTC on March 12, 2026.
The impact began at 14:02 UTC when ledger connection pool exhaustion was detected, causing card payment failures.
The incident was declared SEV1 at 14:15 UTC.
Change CHG-1042 was rolled back at 14:41 UTC, restoring the ledger connection pool to its previous size.
Payments processing recovered at 14:58 UTC, with all payments processing normally restored.
To address the resulting webhook backlog, Change CHG-1045 was executed at 15:05 UTC, scaling the notification worker fleet from 8 to 24 instances.
The webhook backlog was fully cleared by 16:30 UTC.
